Description: Detected a Generic API Key, potentially exposing access to various services and sensitive operations.
Author: Humanoid-Traders
Message:
Live exchange data pipeline + persist scan data + remaining security fixes

- Add _fetch_live_exchange_data() to scan_skill.py: fetches real Bitget
  balance/positions via ccxt sync with UTA mode, reads closed_trades.json
- Persist scan data to DB (scan_cache table) so dashboard survives cold starts
- Portfolio-summary endpoint prefers live circuit_breaker data over stale DB
- Fix JavaScript falsy bug: 0 || cachedValue replaced with != null ternary
- JWT auto-generate only in non-production/ephemeral mode (clustered deploy safe)
- Gate /portfolio and /risk/status behind Bearer token (F-08/F-09)
- Disable FastAPI docs/redoc/openapi endpoints (schema exposure)
- Document two-auth-stack boundary in docs/SECURITY_BOUNDARIES.md
